name: item-matched-fist-visuals
description: Owns and equips every configured normal and premium fist (currently 19). Five use actual shared native geometry; fourteen retain approved imported mesh checks. Preserves aura budgets, reduced-motion suppression, and premium punch attachment.

args.code:
local H=game:GetService('HttpService')
local G=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.GameConfig)
local c=game.ServerStorage.PunchWallAutomation
local p=game.Players:GetPlayers()[1]
c:Invoke('Reset')
local budget=1 for _,def in ipairs(G.Fists) do budget+=def.cost end
c:Invoke('SetStats',{Coins=budget,Power=1000,Depth=75,WallLevel=99})
for _,def in ipairs(G.Fists) do if def.cost>0 then local r=c:Invoke('BuyFist',def.name) assert(r.ok==true,'buy failed '..def.name..' '..H:JSONEncode(r)) end end
for _,def in ipairs(G.PremiumFists) do local r=c:Invoke('GrantPremiumFist',def.name) assert(r.ok==true,'grant failed '..def.name..' '..H:JSONEncode(r)) end
local owned=H:JSONDecode(p.RPGStats.OwnedFistsJSON.Value)
for _,name in ipairs(H:JSONDecode(p.RPGStats.OwnedPremiumFistsJSON.Value)) do table.insert(owned,name) end
local all=G.AllFists() assert(#all==#G.Fists+#G.PremiumFists,'combined catalog count drift')
for _,def in ipairs(all) do assert(table.find(owned,def.name),'not owned '..def.name) end
return H:JSONEncode({ok=true,ownedCount=#all,normalCount=#G.Fists,premiumCount=#G.PremiumFists})

args.code:
local H=game:GetService('HttpService')
local RS=game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')
local G=require(RS.GameConfig)
local B=require(RS.FistVisualBuilder)
local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer
local g=p.PlayerGui:WaitForChild('PunchWallHUD')
local a=g:WaitForChild('PunchWallClientAutomation')
local remote=RS.PunchWallEvents.ActionRequest
local firstNames={'Starter Glove','Boxing Glove','Iron Knuckle','Thunder Fist','Titan Gauntlet'}
local function definition(name) for _,d in ipairs(G.AllFists()) do if d.name==name then return d end end error('missing definition '..name) end
local function untilReady(callback,message,seconds)
 local deadline=os.clock()+(seconds or 5)
 repeat local result=callback() if result then return result end task.wait(.05) until os.clock()>=deadline
 error(message)
end
local function visible(object)
 local node=object
 while node and node~=p.PlayerGui do
  if node:IsA('GuiObject') and not node.Visible then return false end
  if node:IsA('ScreenGui') and not node.Enabled then return false end
  node=node.Parent
 end
 return object:IsDescendantOf(p.PlayerGui)
end
local function catalogModels(root)
 local result={}
 for _,d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
  if d:IsA('Model') and d:GetAttribute('FistCatalogVisual')==true and d:FindFirstChild('Catalog Closed Palm') then table.insert(result,d) end
 end
 return result
end
local function parts(root)
 local result={}
 for _,d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA('BasePart') then assert(not result[d.Name],'duplicate part '..d.Name) result[d.Name]=d end end
 return result
end
local function closeVector(actual,expected,epsilon) return (actual-expected).Magnitude<=(epsilon or .003) end
local function colorNear(a,b) return math.max(math.abs(a.R-b.R),math.abs(a.G-b.G),math.abs(a.B-b.B))<=1/255 end
local function actualBounds(root,frame)
 local low=Vector3.new(math.huge,math.huge,math.huge)
 local high=Vector3.new(-math.huge,-math.huge,-math.huge)
 for _,part in pairs(parts(root)) do
  for x=-1,1,2 do for y=-1,1,2 do for z=-1,1,2 do
   local corner=frame:PointToObjectSpace(part.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(part.Size*Vector3.new(x,y,z)*.5))
   low=Vector3.new(math.min(low.X,corner.X),math.min(low.Y,corner.Y),math.min(low.Z,corner.Z))
   high=Vector3.new(math.max(high.X,corner.X),math.max(high.Y,corner.Y),math.max(high.Z,corner.Z))
  end end end
 end
 return low,high
end
local function verifyVisualHazards(model,preview,hand)
 for _,d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
  assert(not d:IsA('LuaSourceContainer') and not d:IsA('Tool') and not d:IsA('RemoteEvent') and not d:IsA('RemoteFunction') and not d:IsA('BindableEvent') and not d:IsA('BindableFunction') and not d:IsA('ClickDetector') and not d:IsA('ProximityPrompt') and not d:IsA('Sound') and not d:IsA('Humanoid') and not d:IsA('Animator') and not d:IsA('AnimationController') and not d:IsA('BodyMover') and not d:IsA('JointInstance'),'unsafe visual descendant '..d.ClassName)
  if d:IsA('WeldConstraint') then
   assert(not preview and d.ClassName=='WeldConstraint' and d.Enabled==true,'unapproved visual weld')
   local first,second=d.Part0,d.Part1
   local valid=hand and first and second and ((first:IsA('BasePart') and first:IsDescendantOf(model) and second==hand) or (second:IsA('BasePart') and second:IsDescendantOf(model) and first==hand))
   assert(valid,'wrong wrist weld endpoints')
  else
   assert(not d:IsA('Constraint'),'unapproved visual constraint '..d.ClassName)
  end
  if preview then
   assert(not d:IsA('ParticleEmitter') and not d:IsA('Trail') and not d:IsA('Beam') and not d:IsA('Light') and not d:IsA('Highlight'),'effect/physics in preview '..d.ClassName)
  end
 end
end
local function verifyGeometry(model,def,preview)
 assert(model and model:GetAttribute('FistCatalogVisual')==true,'missing real catalog model '..def.name)
 assert(model:GetAttribute('FistVisualKey')==def.name and model:GetAttribute('CatalogGeometryVersion')=='SharedClosedFistV1','catalog identity mismatch '..def.name)
 local spec=assert(B.GetCatalogSpec(def))
 local all=parts(model)
 local palm=assert(all['Catalog Closed Palm'],'missing palm')
 local basePalm
 for _,part in ipairs(spec.parts) do if part.name=='Catalog Closed Palm' then basePalm=part end end
 local scale=palm.Size.X/basePalm.size.X
 assert(scale>0,'invalid uniform scale')
 local count,roles=0,{}
 for _ in pairs(all) do count+=1 end
 assert(count==#spec.parts and count>=12 and count<=22,'extra/missing catalog geometry '..def.name)
 for _,expected in ipairs(spec.parts) do
  local part=assert(all[expected.name],'missing '..expected.name)
  local relative=palm.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(part.CFrame)
  local canonical=basePalm.cframe:ToObjectSpace(expected.cframe)
  assert(part.ClassName=='Part' and part.Shape==expected.shape,'shape mismatch '..expected.name)
  assert(closeVector(part.Size/scale,expected.size),'size mismatch '..expected.name)
  assert(closeVector(relative.Position/scale,canonical.Position,.006),'offset mismatch '..expected.name)
  assert(relative.UpVector:Dot(canonical.UpVector)>.999 and relative.LookVector:Dot(canonical.LookVector)>.999,'rotation mismatch '..expected.name)
  assert(colorNear(part.Color,expected.color) and part.Material==expected.material,'color/material mismatch '..expected.name)
  assert(part:GetAttribute('FistShape')==expected.role,'anatomy role mismatch '..expected.name)
  roles[expected.role]=(roles[expected.role] or 0)+1
  assert(part.Massless and not part.CanCollide and not part.CanTouch and not part.CanQuery and not part.CastShadow,'physical visual '..expected.name)
  assert(part.Anchored==preview,'unexpected anchoring '..expected.name)
 end
 assert(roles.ClosedPalm==1 and roles.ClosedKnuckle==4 and roles.CurledFinger==4 and roles.FoldedThumb==1 and roles.WristCuff==1 and roles.BackhandPlate==1,'incomplete closed anatomy')
 assert(model:GetAttribute('VisualPartCount')==count and model:GetAttribute('WithinVisualPartBudget')==true,'part count metadata drift')
 verifyVisualHazards(model,preview,not preview and p.Character and (p.Character:FindFirstChild('RightHand') or p.Character:FindFirstChild('Right Arm')) or nil)
 return count,scale
end
local function equipped(def)
 remote:FireServer({action='EquipFist',target=def.name})
 return untilReady(function()
  local model=p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild('Equipped Kaiju Gauntlet')
  if p.RPGStats.EquippedFist.Value==def.name and model and model:GetAttribute('DisplayName')==(def.displayName or def.name) and model:GetAttribute('ItemVisualReady')==true then return model end
 end,'equip did not reach ready state '..def.name)
end
local definitions=G.AllFists() local results={} local nativeCount,importedCount=0,0
for i,def in ipairs(definitions) do
 local m=equipped(def) task.wait(.2)
 local activeHand=assert(p.Character:FindFirstChild('RightHand') or p.Character:FindFirstChild('Right Arm'))
 verifyVisualHazards(m,false,activeHand)
 local row
 if B.GetCatalogSpec(def) then
  local models=catalogModels(m) assert(#models==1,'missing/duplicate native catalog child '..def.name)
  local count,scale=verifyGeometry(models[1],def,false)
  local total=0 for _ in pairs(parts(m))do total+=1 end
  assert(total==count and m:GetAttribute('VisualPartCount')==count,'native equipped extra BaseParts')
  assert(m:GetAttribute('VisualSource')=='SharedCatalogGeometry' and m:GetAttribute('VisualSystem')=='ItemMatchedClosedFistV3' and m:GetAttribute('FistVisualKey')==def.name and m:GetAttribute('CatalogGeometryVersion')=='SharedClosedFistV1','native source/identity mismatch')
  nativeCount+=1 row={valid=true,name=def.name,source='SharedCatalogGeometry',parts=count,scale=scale}
 else
  local function near(a,b) return colorNear(a,b) end
  local pr=B.GetHeroGauntletPresentation(def) local hand=p.Character and (p.Character:FindFirstChild('RightHand') or p.Character:FindFirstChild('Right Arm')) local imported=m and m:FindFirstChild('Creator Store Fist Visual') local meshPart,meshId,parts,welds,unsafe,anchored,collidable,plates,fins=nil,'',0,0,0,0,0,0,0 if m then for _,d in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA('BasePart') then parts+=1 if d.Anchored then anchored+=1 end if d.CanCollide or d.CanTouch or d.CanQuery then collidable+=1 end if d.Name:match('^Item '..pr.armorPattern..' Plate %d+$') then plates+=1 end if d.Name:match('^Item '..pr.armorPattern..' Energy Fin %d+$') then fins+=1 end if imported and (d==imported or d:IsDescendantOf(imported)) and d.Name~='Tier Color Shell' and not meshPart then local sm=d:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('SpecialMesh') if d:IsA('MeshPart') and d.MeshId~='' then meshPart=d meshId=d.MeshId elseif sm and sm.MeshId~='' then meshPart=d meshId=sm.MeshId end end elseif d:IsA('WeldConstraint') then welds+=1 elseif d:IsA('LuaSourceContainer') or d:IsA('Tool') or d:IsA('RemoteEvent') or d:IsA('RemoteFunction') or d:IsA('BindableEvent') or d:IsA('BindableFunction') or d:IsA('ClickDetector') or d:IsA('ProximityPrompt') or d:IsA('Sound') or d:IsA('Humanoid') or d:IsA('Animator') or d:IsA('AnimationController') then unsafe+=1 end end end local core=m and m:FindFirstChild('Hero Core Gem',true) local cuff=m and m:FindFirstChild('Tier Wrist Cuff',true) local expectedCore=def.tier>=4 local coreValid=(expectedCore and core and core.Shape==Enum.PartType.Block and core.Size.Z<=0.13) or ((not expectedCore) and core==nil) local minParts=3+pr.plateCount+pr.finCount+(expectedCore and 1 or 0) local axisDot=(meshPart and hand) and meshPart.CFrame.UpVector:Dot(hand.CFrame.UpVector) or 1 local boundsCenter=m and m:GetBoundingBox().Position local localCenter=(boundsCenter and hand) and hand.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(boundsCenter) or Vector3.new(99,99,99) local valid=m and hand and imported and meshPart and meshId~='' and cuff and m:GetAttribute('VisualSystem')=='ItemMatchedClosedFistV3' and m:GetAttribute('VisualSource')=='SanitizedCreatorStoreMesh' and m:GetAttribute('VisualTemplate')=='CreatorStore_ArmoredClosedHeroFist' and m:GetAttribute('ImportedRuntimeSilhouette')==true and m:GetAttribute('SilhouetteFamily')=='ClosedHeroFist' and m:GetAttribute('GripAxis')=='LocalYToDistalForearm' and axisDot<=-0.9 and math.abs(localCenter.X)<=1.1 and localCenter.Y<=0.35 and localCenter.Y>=-1.4 and math.abs(localCenter.Z)<=1.1 and m:GetAttribute('ArmorPattern')==pr.armorPattern and m:GetAttribute('ShopArtVariant')==pr.shopArtKey and m:GetAttribute('ShopArtMatchedTier')==def.tier and m:GetAttribute('ItemColorMatched')==true and m:GetAttribute('ItemMaterialMatched')==true and m:GetAttribute('WristAttachmentBounded')==true and m:GetAttribute('FaceOcclusionSafe')==true and m:GetAttribute('WithinVisualPartBudget')==true and m:GetAttribute('WholeHandHidden')==false and m:GetAttribute('HandTransparencyPreserved')==true and hand.Transparency<1 and near(meshPart.Color,def.color) and meshPart.Material==def.material and plates==pr.plateCount and fins==pr.finCount and coreValid and m:GetAttribute('HasEnergyCore')==expectedCore and m:GetAttribute('HasWristCuff')==true and m:FindFirstChild('Hero Gauntlet Palm Shell',true)==nil and m:FindFirstChild('Hero Knuckle Plate 1',true)==nil and parts>=minParts and parts<=28 and welds>=parts and m:GetAttribute('VisualPartCount')==parts and anchored==0 and collidable==0 and unsafe==0 row={valid=valid==true,name=def.name,tier=def.tier,style=def.style,template=m and m:GetAttribute('VisualTemplate') or '',gripAxis=m and m:GetAttribute('GripAxis') or '',axisDot=axisDot,localX=localCenter.X,localY=localCenter.Y,localZ=localCenter.Z,colorMatched=meshPart and near(meshPart.Color,def.color) or false,materialMatched=meshPart and meshPart.Material==def.material or false,core=core~=nil,expectedCore=expectedCore,cuff=cuff~=nil,plates=plates,expectedPlates=pr.plateCount,fins=fins,expectedFins=pr.finCount,parts=parts,minParts=minParts,welds=welds,anchored=anchored,collidable=collidable,unsafe=unsafe,mesh=meshId,source=m and m:GetAttribute('VisualSource') or '',system=m and m:GetAttribute('VisualSystem') or ''} assert(valid,'item-matched fist anatomy failed '..H:JSONEncode(row))
  importedCount+=1
 end
 results[i]=row
end
assert(#results==#definitions and nativeCount==5 and importedCount==#definitions-5,'configured catalog matrix incomplete')
return H:JSONEncode({ok=true,count=#results,normalCount=#G.Fists,premiumCount=#G.PremiumFists,nativeCount=nativeCount,importedCount=importedCount,results=results})

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer local gui=p.PlayerGui:WaitForChild('PunchWallHUD') local a=gui:WaitForChild('PunchWallClientAutomation') local remote=game.ReplicatedStorage.PunchWallEvents.ActionRequest remote:FireServer({action='EquipFist',target='Celestial Titan Fist'}) local m local deadline=os.clock()+5 repeat task.wait(.05) m=p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild('Equipped Kaiju Gauntlet') until os.clock()>=deadline or (m and m:GetAttribute('Tier')==8 and m:GetAttribute('ItemVisualReady')==true) task.wait(.3) local function enabledCount() local n=0 for _,d in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA('ParticleEmitter') and d:GetAttribute('FistAuraEffect')==true and d.Enabled then n+=1 end end return n end local fullBefore=enabledCount() a:Invoke('SetSettings',{motion=false,persist=false}) task.wait(.1) local reduced=enabledCount() local suppressed=m:GetAttribute('AuraReducedMotionSuppressed')==true and m:GetAttribute('AuraParticlesEnabled')==false a:Invoke('SetSettings',{motion=true,persist=false}) task.wait(.1) local restored=enabledCount() local valid=fullBefore==2 and reduced==0 and suppressed and restored==2 local result={valid=valid,fullBefore=fullBefore,reduced=reduced,suppressed=suppressed,restored=restored,totalRate=m:GetAttribute('AuraTotalRate') or 0} assert(valid,'aura reduced-motion gate failed '..H:JSONEncode(result)) return H:JSONEncode(result)
